name: The Ranch at Laguna Beach
positioning: Canyon-to-ocean resort in Laguna Beach's Aliso Canyon, a short walk or shuttle ride from Aliso Beach
best_for: Couples and families wanting a canyon setting close to the beach
Casual golfers who want a 9-hole course on site
Travelers drawn to farm, spa and outdoor wellness experiences

facts.text: The Ranch at Laguna Beach is tucked between a coastal canyon and the Pacific Ocean.
The resort is located in Aliso Canyon.
The resort is surrounded by 87 acres of protected coastal land.
The resort is about 350 yards from the beach.
Guests can reach Aliso Beach by the beach path or a complimentary shuttle.
The Cottage Suites are two-level, two-bedroom suites.
Canyon Rooms offer a king bed, expansive views and indoor-outdoor space.
The saline pool is heated year-round and has a hot tub and a pool bar.
House of Hudson Spa offers personalized treatments and holistic therapies.
The resort's 9-hole golf course is set into the walls of Aliso Canyon.
Lost Pier Cafe on Aliso Beach is a sandy beachside cafe with a full bar.
Aliso Creek runs through the property.

highlights.text: The Treehouse suite is nestled high above the grounds, surrounded by windows, with an expansive wraparound deck and a full gourmet kitchen.
Guests can explore Harvest Farm with the farm team on guided walks.
The golf course hosts three-club barefoot tournaments for novices, families and avid golfers.
An on-site glass-bottle crusher turns used bottles into sand for the golf-course bunkers.
The Revitalize Experience delivers concierge wellness services privately to Canyon Rooms, Cottage Suites or outdoor wellness spaces.

considerations.text: The resort is not on the beach itself: Aliso Beach is about an 8-minute walk along the Beach Path, or a ride on the complimentary shuttle.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability during peak seasons.
